media.sensitive_image.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Imagem sensível} many {# de imagens sensíveis} other {# imagens sensíveis}}
media.sensitive_image.description: The line above a post's images marked sensitive, which stay blurred until the reader shows them, followed by a Show (media.show) or Hide (media.hide) button. count is how many; one alone has no number.

media.sensitive_video.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Vídeo sensível} many {# de vídeos sensíveis} other {# vídeos sensíveis}}
media.sensitive_video.description: The line above a post's videos marked sensitive, which stay blurred until the reader shows them, followed by a Show or Hide button. count is how many; one alone has no number.

media.sensitive_gif.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {GIF sensível} many {# de GIFs sensíveis} other {# GIFs sensíveis}}
media.sensitive_gif.description: The line above a post's GIFs (short silent loops) marked sensitive, which stay blurred until the reader shows them, followed by a Show or Hide button. count is how many; one alone has no number.

media.sensitive_audio.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Áudio sensível} many {# de áudios sensíveis} other {# áudios sensíveis}}
media.sensitive_audio.description: The line above a post's sounds marked sensitive, which stay folded away until the reader shows them, followed by a Show or Hide button. count is how many; one alone has no number.

media.sensitive_file.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Arquivo sensível} many {# de arquivos sensíveis} other {# arquivos sensíveis}}
media.sensitive_file.description: The line above a post's attached files (of a kind the client cannot show) marked sensitive, which stay folded away until the reader shows them, followed by a Show or Hide button. count is how many; one alone has no number.

media.sensitive_mixed.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# anexo sensível} many {# de anexos sensíveis} other {# anexos sensíveis}}
media.sensitive_mixed.description: The line above a post's sensitive media of several kinds (such as images and a sound), covered until the reader shows them, followed by a Show or Hide button. count is how many, at least two.

media.show.description: The button at the end of the line above covered sensitive media that shows it; the same word and look as disclosure.show, the content warning's.

media.hide.description: The button at the end of the line above shown sensitive media that covers it again; the same word and look as disclosure.hide, the content warning's.

media.alt.description: The mark in the corner of a picture that has a description (alternative text); hidden from screen readers, which read the description itself. Keep it short; ALT is understood in most languages.

media.gif.description: The mark in the corner of a short looping animation without sound; hidden from screen readers, whose name for it says GIF (media.open).

media.play.description: The screen reader's name of the play button on a video in a post without a description; the video plays in place.

media.play_described.description: The screen reader's name of the play button on a video in a post with a description (alternative text); the video plays in place. description is the poster's own text, in any language.

media.open.description: The screen reader's name of a picture in a post without a description, a button that opens it whole in the media viewer; kind is gifv for a short silent loop, else image.

media.open_described.description: The screen reader's name of a picture in a post with a description (alternative text), a button that opens it whole in the media viewer; kind is gifv for a short silent loop, else image; description is the poster's own text, in any language.

media.whole.description: The button in the corner of a video in a post that opens it whole in the media viewer, over the page.

media.file.description: The text of a link to an attached file of a kind the client cannot show, when neither its description nor its address gives a name for it; the host it is on shows under it, and it opens in a new tab.

media.new_tab.description: Said after a link that opens in a new tab (an attached file, the card of a link in a post), for assistive technology; the same words as app.new_tab.

media.audio_play.description: The button of an attached sound in a post that plays it; its description, or the word for a sound (media.audio), is next to it.

media.audio_pause.description: The button of an attached sound in a post that pauses it while it plays.

media.audio_time.description: What a screen reader reads for the time of an attached sound in a post, in place of the visible 0:07 / 3:12: at is how far it has played, length its whole length, both as a player shows them (0:07, 3:12).

media.audio.description: What an attached sound without a description is called, in the row that plays it.
